A '''supernova''' occurred<ref name="Power of the Jedi" /> shortly before [[3996 BBY]]<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia" /> that destroyed the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryyk]]. The remnants of the event formed the [[Ryyk Nebula/Legends|Ryyk Nebula]]<ref name="Power of the Jedi" /> by around [[3963 BBY]].<ref name="Kotor16 Date">[[Knights of the Old Republic 16|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 16]] states that its events take place approximately 3,963 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the Battle to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] thus the events must take place around [[3963 BBY]].</ref>
